description: Uploads files into a file field and reads, renames and searches files. upload sends the content as base64 (at most 3 MB) and, with recordId, writes the file into that record's file field at once; mode append adds it after the existing files (default when the field holds several), replace keeps only the new file (default for single-file fields). Without recordId the file stays pending for 24 hours and reaches a record when its id is written into a file field as part of the field's full list of file ids. create_upload is for larger files and coding agents: it returns a PUT URL with headers that accepts exactly size bytes for 15 minutes, a curl command and the fileId of the pending file. attach writes a pending file into a record's file field: a file attached to a chat message (its fileId is in the message) or an upload without recordId. It is a record update like upload with recordId (mode append or replace, expectedVersion); a file already in that field is returned unchanged, and once attached the record's and field's access rules apply to it. read takes a fileId from a file value, a record's files list or a chat attachment and returns the file's details, a downloadUrl that works for 15 minutes and, once text extraction has run, the file's text in chunks: offset 0 starts the text and each result's nextOffset continues it until it is null. rename gives a file a new name (folders are refused; a name without an extension keeps the current one); for a file in a record's file field it is a record update that needs edit access to the field and shows in the record's activity. search finds files the caller can read by the words in their extracted text and returns each with its record, a snippet and the offset to read from. A file leaves a record when the field's list is written without its id. Uploads count against the workspace storage and the size limit per file. Extracted text and snippets arrive between untrusted-content markers.

action.description: upload: typeId, fieldId, name, mimeType, content, recordId, mode, expectedVersion; create_upload: typeId, fieldId, name, mimeType, size; read: fileId, offset; attach: fileId, typeId, recordId, fieldId, mode, expectedVersion; rename: fileId, name; search: query, limit.

content.description: upload: the file content as base64 (a data URL prefix is allowed), at most 3 MB decoded.

expectedVersion.description: upload with recordId and attach: the record version the write is based on; the current version when omitted.

fieldId.description: File field that receives the file.

fileId.description: read: a file id from a file value, a record's files list or a file the user attached in a chat. attach: a pending file uploaded by the caller, such as a file the user attached in a chat. rename: a file in a record's file field or a pending file uploaded by the caller.

limit.description: search: how many files to return, at most 10.

mimeType.description: Media type such as application/pdf; an unknown type is stored as application/octet-stream.

mode.description: upload with recordId and attach: append adds the file after the existing ones (default for fields that hold several files); replace keeps only the new file (default for single-file fields).

name.description: File name shown to people, such as Offer 2026.pdf. rename: the new name; without an extension the file keeps its current one.

offset.description: read: character offset into the extracted text, 0 or the prior nextOffset.

query.description: search: words to find in the text of the files the caller can read.

recordId.description: upload: the record whose file field receives the file at once; without it the file stays pending. attach: the record whose file field receives the file.

size.description: create_upload: the exact size of the file in bytes.

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: manage_record_files

attached.description: upload and attach: whether the file was written into the record's file field.

curl.description: create_upload: a ready curl command with a placeholder file path.

downloadUrl.description: read: a link to the file content valid for 15 minutes.

items.description: search: matching files, best first, each with its record, a snippet between untrusted-content markers and the offset to read from.

operationId.description: upload and attach: the id of a background operation that finishes the write.

text.description: read: a chunk of the extracted text between untrusted-content markers.

textAvailable.description: read: whether the file's extracted text can be read.

untrustedTextHandling.description: Present when the result holds marked untrusted text; how to treat the text between the markers.

upload.description: create_upload: the upload target, which accepts exactly size bytes sent to url with method and headers until expiresAt.

title: Upload, attach and read record files
